mo_ta_cong_viec:
We are looking for an IT Project Manager who can take full ownership of project delivery, from planning through execution.
In CRV’s delivery environment, this role goes beyond coordination and status reporting. The successful candidate is expected to combine:
strong project planning and control
hands-on involvement in execution details when needed
sufficient technical awareness to follow solution discussions and validate delivery direction
This role is well suited to someone who is comfortable working across both the big picture and execution detail, and who can actively drive delivery through clear understanding, close follow-up, timely decisions, and strong stakeholder alignment.
Key Responsibilities
Build and manage detailed project plans, including scope, timeline, milestones, dependencies, and key deliverables
Proactively track project progress, identify gaps early, and adjust or re-plan when needed
Work closely with Business, BA, Technical teams, and Vendors to ensure execution remains on track and aligned
Stay involved at the detail level when required, especially in areas related to requirements, deliverables, issue resolution, and execution dependencies
Develop a solid understanding of solution flow and system interactions in order to identify risks, gaps, or unclear directions early
Ensure vendor scope, deliverables, and commitments are clearly defined, monitored, and validated throughout the project lifecycle
Maintain strong control over timeline, quality, and overall delivery outcome
yeu_cau:
5+ years of experience
Proven experience in IT project delivery, preferably in system implementation or enterprise application projects
Strong capability in planning, tracking, and delivery control, with the ability to respond proactively when issues arise
Comfortable working hands-on with execution details when required, not only at a summary level
Able to understand solution flow, business process, and system interactions sufficiently to support project control and challenge gaps appropriately
Experience working with cross-functional teams, external vendors, and multiple stakeholders
Strong ownership mindset, with good problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills
Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or a related field
Experience in retail, omni-channel, or large-scale integration projects is an advantage
 
What We Expect
This role requires more than project coordination and reporting
The Project Manager is expected to actively drive execution, not only monitor status
The successful candidate should be comfortable balancing planning, execution, stakeholder alignment, and delivery quality
We value individuals who can identify risks early, ask the right questions, and take timely action to keep delivery under control
 
Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate is someone who:
can manage both strategic view and execution detail
is comfortable moving between planning, follow-up, issue resolution, and stakeholder alignment
is able to work with BA, Technical teams, and Vendors with enough depth to maintain delivery control
takes ownership of project outcomes and maintains momentum in a complex, fast-moving environment
